name: hvalec-site
description: Orchestrates three independent frontend projects (main/, profile/, admin/) into one shared dist/. Each project builds and can be worked on entirely on its own — this just assembles them.

scripts.build: npm run build:main:production && npm run build:profile && npm run build:admin && npm run finalize
scripts.build:staging: npm run build:main:staging && npm run build:profile && npm run build:admin && npm run finalize
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:main:dev && npm run build:profile && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:main:production: cd main && bundle install && bundle exec jekyll build --config _config.yml,_config_production.yml
scripts.build:main:staging: cd main && bundle install && bundle exec jekyll build --config _config.yml,_config_staging.yml
scripts.build:main:dev: cd main && bundle install && bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.build:profile: cd profile && npm run build && cd .. && mkdir -p dist/profile && cp -R profile/dist/. dist/profile/
scripts.build:admin: cd admin && npm run build && cd .. && mkdir -p dist/admin && cp -R admin/dist/. dist/admin/
